source_domain_A: EO01 physical contact gate, unchanged two scalar codec and actual post-actuation tactile return

histories.T: EO02_MAIN, real executed action and tactile return
histories.U: AUX_EO02_U, same complete prefix, age, raw samples and generic resources; tactile omitted, not universally naive
histories.H: AUX_EO02_H, same prefix and resource calendar; tactile posture decoupled where actual contact exists, not identical physical history

destination_B: Two isolated local service workers chosen by native direction, actual bounded file work and receipts. Its admission law shares the source calibrated comparison; this is explicitly isomorphic transfer under a shared sensor representation, not abstract cross-task reasoning.
destination_C: Two-stage local transaction: prepare work under the same local eligibility relation, then verify/commit by a different worker. Previous executed worker matters for commit; a copied scalar comparison alone does not solve the whole objective.
first_response: Decode before any feedback for this opportunity; later responses may be new learning.
transfer_primary_test: T first destination useful action differs from U/H after source histories, with no destination alignment experience before that response. Measure initial advantage separately from subsequent learning.
retention_criterion: First return-to-A response before its tactile feedback and the next two responses separately; no restoration or re-teaching hidden.
control_of_wrong_transfer: Destination calibration6 is a relation-different condition where blindly reusing source14 may hurt; fixed finite three-opportunity diagnostic copies.
reserved_preconditions: Freeze exact code, sensory contract, observations, domains, metrics and assistance after bounded pilot and before opening held-out conditions; later revisions need new reserves.
